title: Wernher von Braun's Project Mars and a leader called 'Elon'

tellings.quote: in 1952 former Nazi and father of the American Space Program wner Von braa published a science fiction book titled project Mars a technical Tale in this novel he predicted a future mission to colonize Mars led by a figure referred to as Elon

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1952 Wernher von Braun, a former Nazi rocket engineer he calls the father of the American space program, published a science fiction novel called Project Mars: A Technical Tale. According to Michels, the book predicted a future mission to settle Mars led by a figure called Elon. He tells it in an episode about whether the mind can glimpse the future, since the name would then be an eerie piece of foresight.
